published_failure_contract: JUnit Platform listener discovery aborts before tests because SmokeTestExtension cannot be instantiated.

source_isolation.evidence: The commit adds Constants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY to log4j-api and makes log4j-core ConfigurationSource read it. A1 retains API 2.14.1; the Surefire dump exposes NoSuchFieldError: EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY at ConfigurationSource.<clinit>, which is wrapped by the published ServiceConfigurationError.

a1_input.evidence: The merged PR changes only log4j-core 2.14.1 to 2.15.0 and native replay reproduces the exact public top-level error before any test executes.

target_history.evidence: The direct child of A1 is authored by the project maintainer and synchronizes log4j-api while retaining core 2.15.0. The exact one-line hunk is sufficient under the unchanged native test contract; the same commit's SmokeRunner removal is an independent mixed change.

label_boundary: Accepted as a coordinated Log4j API/Core binary-compatibility repair. The label does not attribute the failure to the Log4Shell security mitigation as a whole.

published_failure_contract: ParallelConnectionsTest receives an HTTP 500 from the local proxied backend; the retained client stack has no backend exception or Log4j frame.

source_isolation.evidence: A Core/API mismatch is plausible for the one-sided substitution, but the public HTTP 500 contains no server-side NoSuchFieldError, Log4j initialization frame or backend log. The remote response alone cannot establish the source mechanism.

a1_input.evidence: The Dependabot PR head changes only test-scope log4j-core 2.14.1 to 2.15.0, but no head or tag contains it and the workbook records no target revision.

target_history.evidence: All refs contain no maintainer recovery retaining 2.15.0. Mainline later skips to synchronized log4j-jcl/core 2.16.0.

stop_reason: There is no fixed-2.15.0 maintainer A2 and the retained HTTP 500 is not source-specific. An author-synchronized 2.15.0 build would not be maintainer recovery evidence.
